t: The Titan TTB1800SR scarifier is an essential electric garden tool for effective lawn care, designed to remove moss and thatch from lawns. Ideal for professional landscapers and serious DIYers maintaining healthy grass areas. It features a 37cm working width and a versatile cutting height range from -12mm to +10mm, ensuring thorough lawn renovation. The 2-in-1 system allows for quick changes between aeration teeth and scarifying knives, while a 45L collection bag minimises interruptions. Vertical storage and central height adjustment enhance user convenience.
